# FFmpeg 1.1.6 binaries

The Git repository excludes compiled binaries. Copy the verified `ffmpeg.exe`
and `ffprobe.exe` from the 1.1.6 Offline Developer Kit to `ffmpeg/bin/`.
The exact hashes and source mapping are in ../FFMPEG-MANIFEST.json.
Publish the corresponding Perplex-FFmpeg-Source-1.1.6.zip alongside binary assets.
Do not substitute the old Gyan binaries.
